shorts.hook: In 1969, a physicist guessed how long the Berlin Wall would stand. He was right.
shorts.spoken: In 1969, a physicist guessed how long the Berlin Wall would stand. Twenty years later, he was proved right.

shorts.spoken: Your train is forty minutes late, and the board says ten more. Should you believe it?
